g.text: TrendDetective (data-expansion @ 524818c) — Feature gaps between the work areas
Areas are now predefined regions evaluated with all stations inside (area_analysis); drawn shapes were removed.
All topics of all providers are offered everywhere; marine and many hourly topics still fail at most places. ★ The coverage box explains afterwards which years have data.
Marine fetches are split by month, DWD / FMI / PolarWatch are chunked, but NOAA daily and hourly point requests still download the whole range at once.
split_by_variable gives one card per NOAA code (TMAX, TMIN, …).
Apply is enabled without a point or region; the point flow then silently uses Washington DC.
② require area or ③ error
Cards show Mann-Kendall (trend, p, tau, z, S) and unavailable t-Tests.
analyze_trend (p, CI, r²) is used for regions and /api/analyze, but the point flow still uses LinearRegression.process on positions 0..n-1, so no significance and gaps compress the time axis.
Chart has date ticks and the unit on the y-axis.
Regions draw coloured station dots per key, but point results still stack one feature per key on the same geometry; without LR every feature is blue.
Drawn areas are gone; points are wrapped. Remaining region case is G19.
Codes get readable labels (variable_label), but the topic list still shows keys like "wet_bulb_temperature".
/api/buttons replies with send_error (HTML) and does not catch RuntimeError / SourceError; the page shows a generic message.
★ 6 providers registered; the point flow asks all that cover the place and keeps the nearest station.
★ Region results carry sources, duplicates_removed, duplicates and source_errors; the cards show none of them (only the map popup shows a station's source).
★ /api/coverage only knows NOAA TOPICS, so empty cards from DWD / ECCC / FMI / ERA5 / PolarWatch get a 400.
No tool picker in the sidebar; Apply always sends every tool as true. Per-tool choice exists only in the plot panel.
area_analysis reaches into private ④ APIs (_PROVIDERS, NOAAClient._get_json, _normalize_observations); covers / covers_box are looked up with getattr.
★ Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, Helsinki have 0 / 0 station counts; a region bbox with west > east would not be drawn or evaluated correctly.
clearArea() does not fire onAreaCleared, so the page's selectedArea can go stale; setTool is not exposed (needed with hideToolbar).
★ src/test_task.py still patches fetch_data_single_topic_single_coordinate with provider "noaa"; the multi-provider path is untested.
Arrows point from the area that offers a feature to the area that cannot use or deliver it. ★ = new on branch data-expansion, not yet on main.
